This app is awesome. It is very good that the pronunciation symbols are 
written like real sounds(not with a stressed one). I like to use some modes 
to practice. I think I can save more time when the developers add a setting 
to select some modes as user's wish. For example, I would like to play with 
the modes of Vocabulary, Choose phases, Translate phases. I t takes me a 
lot of time to change modes when I finish a mode.
